name: sentriai
description: SentriAI — production-ready multi-tenant AI CCTV SaaS platform with absolute tenant isolation (PostgreSQL RLS + backend authorization).

scripts.build: npm --workspace server run build && npm --workspace web run build
scripts.vercel-build: npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.test: bash scripts/with-postgres.sh npm --workspace server run test:ci
scripts.test:security: bash scripts/with-postgres.sh npm --workspace server run test:security
scripts.pentest: npm run build && bash scripts/with-postgres.sh bash scripts/pentest-gate.sh
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace server run typecheck && npm --workspace web run typecheck
